csv_project_name: Engineering Services for SR 124 Corridor Creek Nation Road
csv_scope_of_work: Jackson County continues to be one of the top fastest growing counties in the United States. State Route 124 is a growing corridor in western Jackson County that connects Braselton to the Jefferson area. As the area continues to grow, traffic accidents and congestion continue to be an issue, especially along this corridor. This roadway today is a majority two-lane roadway with some turn lanes into larger neighborhoods and businesses. Heavy growth is expected to occur along this corridor in the coming years as this area continues to see development. Due to the growing nature of the corridor along with the increasing accidents and points of congestion, the Gainesville-Hall Metropolitan Planning Organization, in partnership with Jackson County, would like to conduct a corridor improvement study to help identify short and long-range improvement projects. For this project, GHMPO and Jackson County are seeking a transportation planning and engineering firm to conduct a thorough review of the area, conduct various public engagement opportunities, and identify short and long-range projects for roadway and pedestrian improvements
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Planning/Master Planning, Traffic Design Engineering, Transportation Planning
